operationalLimits.appliesTo: Each emergency diesel engine gen-set (Ref. Nos. EG-01 through EG-59)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: No operation for scheduled maintenance checks and readiness testing (Scheduled MCRT), stack testing, or operation training (that involves fuel combustion) between the hours of 7 a.m. to 5 p.m. any day during May 1 through September 30. The permittee may petition the Regional Air Compliance Manager of DEQ's NRO, for exceptions to this requirement, with approvals made on a case-by-case basis.

operationalLimits.category: Ozone Season Operating Restrictions - Integration Operational Period
operationalLimits.appliesTo: Each emergency diesel engine gen-set (Ref. Nos. EG-01 through EG-59)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: During the integration operational period, any operation of the unit (that involves fuel combustion) between the hours of 7 a.m. to 5 p.m. any day during the ozone season of May 1 through September 30 shall only occur if the forecast Air Quality index (AQI) for ozone as published on the AirNow website (https://airnow.gov) for Northern Virginia for that day is less than or equal to 100. In the event that AirNow-EnviroFlash (www.enviroflash.info) issues an Air Alert for Metropolitan Washington, D.C. for a day which the forecasted AQI for ozone was less than or equal to 100, operation of each unit (which involves fuel combustion) shall be minimized to the maximum extent practical.

operationalLimits.appliesTo: Each individual emergency diesel engine gen-set (Ref. Nos. EG-01 through EG-59)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: Not operate more than 36 hours per year for scheduled maintenance checks and readiness testing (Scheduled MCRT, as provided in Condition 6.c). The annual limits for hours of operation shall be calculated monthly as the sum of each consecutive 12-month period.

operationalLimits.appliesTo: Each individual emergency diesel engine gen-set (Ref. Nos. EG-01 through EG-59)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: Not operate more than 500 hours per year for all purposes (as provided in Condition 6) combined. The annual limits for hours of operation shall be calculated monthly as the sum of each consecutive 12-month period.
Not operate more than 500 hours per year for all purposes. The annual limits for hours of operation shall be calculated daily as the sum of each consecutive 365-day period.

operationalLimits.appliesTo: Emergency diesel engine gen-sets (Ref. Nos. EG-01 through EG-59) and fire pump (Ref. No. FWP-01)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: Diesel fuel oil (ultra-low sulfur diesel fuel oil (ULSD), renewable diesel, or a blend of these fuels) meeting ASTM D975 for grade ultra-low sulfur 2-D or Grade 2-D S15, OR having a maximum sulfur content not to exceed 0.0015% by weight (15 ppm), and either a minimum cetane number of 40 or maximum aromatic content of 35 volume percent.

operationalLimits.appliesTo: Emergency diesel engine gen-sets (Ref. Nos. EG-01 through EG-59) and fire pump (Ref. No. FWP-01) combined
operationalLimits.limitDetails: Consume no more than 664,500 gallons of total ultra-low sulfur diesel fuel oil and renewable diesel fuel per year (all uses), calculated daily as the sum of each consecutive 365-day period.

emissionLimits.appliesTo: Each emergency diesel engine gen-set (Ref. Nos. EG-01 through EG-59) and fire pump (Ref. No. FWP-01) exhausts
emissionLimits.conditions: except during one 6-minute period in any one hour in which visible emissions shall not exceed 10% opacity as determined by EPA Method 9. This condition applies at all times except during startup, shutdown and malfunction.

emissionLimits.appliesTo: Each emergency diesel engine gen-set and fire pump
emissionLimits.conditions: During startup and shutdown, except during one 6-minute period in any one hour in which visible emissions shall not exceed 20% opacity as determined by EPA Method 9.
